claims.statement: Live mutation admission compares the current basis, exact source, writable preimage, and derived postimage before it permits a source write.
Live mutation preparation permanently claims the plan application before recovery preparation and returns a distinct claimed-without-recovery outcome on failure.
The pure live declaration planner produces detached plan proof without granting a published lease or native write authority.
The hosted mutation stores share one admitted SQLite database while preserving distinct database, plan, and receipt failure causes.
Recovery persists exact pre-write evidence and distinguishes preparation from independently observed application and rollback.
Live declaration verification replays retained relation, traversal, and diagnostic requests with their original scopes and grants under a fresh compiler anchor.
Complete and Qualified semantic outcomes carry an EvidenceEnvelope, while Rejected carries only the operation-owned reason and no successful payload.
Read recovery actions are finite directions derived exhaustively from rejection data; they grant no retry, refresh or mutation capability.
LiveReadEvidence is detached provenance and cannot acquire or restore live execution authority.
One-shot tool RPC rejects stopped or unproven installation admission with INSTALLATION_STOPPED before argument admission, workspace discovery, preparation or semantic dispatch.

Impact ledger construction accounts for every admitted seed, observed native branch and applicable reviewed model alternative before deriving closure; native branch accounting preserves exact origin history and preceding model steps, while required path obligations or weaker producer identity retain unresolved closure.

Every independently native-admitted requested site retains reached original paths, exact site and domain exclusions, or an unproven relationship; unmatched requested sites add a required relationship obligation that prevents semantic completion.

A guarded peer continuation retains its independently completed target read and reviewed model edge, ends with PEER_FLOW_NOT_INVESTIGATED and a required BOUNDARY obligation, and does not admit peer flow observations into the source investigation.

Public RUN uses the fixed COMPLETE_ONLY model COMPILER_RESOLVED_STATIC_V1; source-symbol TRACE can retain SOURCE_RELATIONSHIPS with callbackEffects EVIDENCE_ONLY, while explicit relation, traversal, composition and retained-source paths keep stricter callback proof.
Completion rejection retains original coverage and typed causes; retained evidence supplies public nextQuery arguments and EVIDENCE_ONLY interpretation without granting semantic replay.

Public result projection keeps accumulated logical row counts, INLINE or PREFIX preview, typed stops, independent row and evidence positions, and retained output without strengthening original coverage.

Compact relation graph node, connection and witness IDs belong to their retained basis; exact selectors remain separate, and the detail request retrieves verbose retained evidence without granting live declaration authority.
MCP semantic documents remain distinct from MCP_REJECTED transport errors; overlapping invocation admission returns INVOCATION_IN_PROGRESS without claiming failure of the active semantic query.
SemanticReadAuthority distinguishes published leases from original-owner live admissions, and requiring published authority from a live admission rejects.
Decoded live read references prove representation validity only; the original host must re-admit the current epoch, and live authority cannot be copied, parsed or used to manufacture a generation.
SourceReadService admits its context before reading, admits it again before publication and rejects a changed context or contradictory snapshot.

Local exact references preserve admitted local addresses and require ORIGINAL_DOCUMENT unchanged whole owning-file content plus saved committed PSI and fresh compiler confirmation for reacquisition; edited locals require rediscovery rather than name rebinding.

Anonymous objects and their members preserve compiler-owned local addresses; source lookup selects actual object-literal PSI and revalidates exact ranges and compiler evidence without inventing qualified identity.
Semantic read authority is closed over published leases and original-owner live IDE admission; requirePublished explicitly rejects live authority.
A decoded live reference proves representation validity only; its original owner must re-admit the current epoch and selectors must recheck scope, declaration, and content.

LiveMutationAuthority retains the current admitted observation, exact plan, saved preimage and derived postimage only after permanent application claim and durable recovery preparation; it contains no verified signing approval.

The active Gradle graph includes the existing-IDE hosted runtime and retained topology modules, but does not include the retired importer, coordinator, indexer, isolated server or composition modules.
The hosted runtime composes live topology contracts, build logic, and IntelliJ dependency capture while historical graph service and SQLite capture remain separate.

Control and Host use the existing process boundary and domain modules, but package their own runtime dependencies under independent artifact and release owners; Control metadata has no host archive dependency.
When semantic fixtures are enabled, root check enforces reviewed resource identity, FIR inventory accounting, and exact successful execution of declared native cases.
The hosted runtime directly composes topology contract, build, and IntelliJ modules for live semantic dependencies, while historical graph services and topology SQLite remain separate.

Managed Host bundle refresh admits only NativeHostBundleRefreshRoot.submit with its exact method descriptor and the exact VfsUtil.markDirty and LocalFileSystem.refreshFiles signatures. Other callers, overloads, Gradle import, workspace refresh entry points, and passive-read modules remain rejected.

The cli module composes the distribution:cli management implementation through an exact architecture-policy edge and produces the shared native Control executable. The management module keeps no IntelliJ, semantic, MCP implementation, or App Server implementation dependency.
Query row admission proves legal stage and output transitions before effects and rejects incomplete right inputs for difference and anti join.
QueryService keeps stage work, output evidence, accounting, and checkpoint construction in one ordered task interpreter.
Inner joins keep both named symbol cells and their evidence, while join build and probe work remains inside the existing query interpreter.
QueryStateStore keeps checkpoints, immutable results, output pages, and publication claims under one bounded lifetime and quota.
Retained presentation preserves original authority, qualification, and separate row and evidence cursor progress without semantic replay.
Hosted query publication binds fitted encoded output to an owned commit or cancellation release rather than publishing uncommitted retained state.
HostedEndpointService owns the existing IDEA project's endpoint, explicit lifecycle composition, and retirement under the plugin service registration.
Hosted connection admission bounds concurrent jobs with configured permits. After accept, the listener waits for a permit before another dispatch. Each connection releases its permit in finally.
The read executor and hosted publication session preserve admitted budgets, cancellation settlement, full-envelope fitting, and owned publication commit.
IDE lifecycle state binds projects and bounded operations to host, root, ownership, client, and request identities while keeping native effects outside its monitor.
Hosted workspace refresh uses one service for explicit queued effects and status, with task completion and imported-model evidence under separate admitted owners.
The passive read refresh path requests file comparison and maps only terminal outcomes into read readiness without granting arbitrary import authority.
Callback fact reuse needs complete dependency continuity under the original live owner and fresh compiler admission of retained endpoints.
Callback summary capture needs an exhaustive scan, while optional storage follows final flow and owner-binding admission.
Complete static callback graph admission rejects unresolved or unsupported invocation evidence before query completion can use it.

Subject restoration keeps the scope that admitted the exact subject. Callback evidence uses owned production, test, and generated workspace sources, excludes library bodies, and keeps the original read authority and shared work and time limits.

Callback result membership keeps the subject, authority, selected result domain, relationship direction, and exact graph site. A complete callback graph without this membership cannot produce a complete answer. Existing graph failures keep their original cause.
Callback evidence inventory reuse shares the original retention slot and separates its purpose and evidence domain from ordinary REFERENCES and other callback evidence domains.
Callback argument binding uses compiler-mapped callable and formal parameter identity and rejects invocations or parameters outside their admitted owners.
Callback invocation flow preserves lexical and anonymous-body ownership instead of treating containment as a named caller edge.
Dependency callback admission uses declared effects or the exact reviewed kotlin.lazy model and does not derive external behavior from dependency PSI bodies.
Scoped discovery applies cheap source and declaration constraints before native enumeration and expensive compiler refinement.
Exact PSI lookup stays within the selected file, excludes filesystem containers, and preserves stale, ambiguous, and unsupported matching declarations.
Exact revalidation needs current live authority from the original root and host, fresh compiler confirmation, policy-specific identity equality, and final authority admission.
Workspace model capture uses the existing IDEA imported model and preserves named Gradle source ownership rather than starting a second importer.
The hosted read transaction runs the full evaluator between freshness checks without a surrounding platform read lock.
Semantic dependency reuse needs current original-owner environment continuity and matching source and resolution inventories beyond a matching epoch signal.
SemanticReadAuthority separates published leases from original-owner live IDEA admission and rejects live authority at effects that need publication.
A detached live reference proves representation validity only, while the private original owner must admit current epoch evidence before selectors recheck source and compiler identity.
Admitted execution budgets keep requested, default, ceiling, effective, and clamp facts for each resource while respecting deadline and transport capacity.
Live dependency snapshots compare current-owner environment continuity, complete resolution inputs, dependency domains, and source content before fact reuse.
The native dependency capture scope charges preparation cost even when reuse eligibility fails and releases native carriers before return.
SemanticCallbackFactStore keeps bounded complete facts under one original authority and permanent retirement.
WorkspacePreparations owns one native preparation sequence per canonical root and separates passive historical observation from authorized retries.
PreparedWorkspaceDemand inspects exact current host identity before dispatch and limits recovery to explicit presemantic cases.
WorkspaceExecution gives each workspace one active semantic permit, bounded queue admission, and one aggregate interaction budget.
